placements.title: Recurring operations change on a shared start date and run by explicit rules
placements.frame: When the team changes how recurring work is staffed, handed off or replenished, what rule does each arrangement run by, and what start date ties the changes together?
placements.why: The position carries Priya's fortnightly intake rota with a fifteen-minute overlap call at each hand-off and Dario's below-a-third-full restocking rule, both tied to a November 1 start. None of the three existing leaves (anti-Slack positioning, decision capture, evaporating decisions) bears on how the team runs its own operations. The theme is something future calls can keep feeding: rota changes, restocking thresholds, start dates. The leaf names the theme and does not restate the facts.

unconnected.why: No existing stratum holds this theme. It is the graph's first operations-oriented narrative, so a stratum would have no second member to group it with yet.
